dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-intensity, light-colored perimeters against a dark background. These perimeters show irregular, undulating geometries with a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior into the light-colored ring, followed by a secondary transition into a dark central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, asymmetrical, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated along the upper dorsal boundary. These localized blobs lack internal gradients and appear as solid, high-contrast points compared to the surrounding dark pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central and upper-left regions form an obtuse scalene triangle. A cluster of four high-intensity blobs at the top-right forms an elongated, irregular quadrilateral arrangement.
